eligibility_note: Exclusion E1 is correct. The paper analyses one country: five-wave VARHS household panel, 2008-2016, 'more than 2100 rural households from twelve provinces across Vietnam'. The multi-country table (Asian income and internet penetration, 2008-2021) is descriptive only, with no estimation on it. There is no explicit income-group comparison across economies. The only heterogeneity is poor vs non-poor households inside Vietnam. Fails the 10-economy / income-group criterion.
income_group_note: No comparison of World Bank income groups; single lower-middle-income country, household-level only.

risk_of_bias.why: Record is an exclusion with no extraction, so no rating is needed.

problems: none. Record correctly excluded; the notes and rationale match the text (single economy, VARHS 2008-2016, poverty outcome).
